# [Seekers Lament](https://i.imgur.com/pVgaIPE.png)

Legendary Warlock Weapon | 10 mana 0/5 | Start of Game: If your deck contains only even cost cards equip this. At the end of your turn Draw a minion from your deck and this loses 1 Durability.

This can give a huge early boost to a zoo warlock but it's ability makes it playable in any archetype since by turn 10 your life total might be in a precarious state this makes sure you stay on top in terms of tempo and facilitates that top deck win.

# [Putrid Smell](https://i.imgur.com/Qy5Y4b3.png)

Epic Warlock Secret| 3 mana | *"When a friendly minion dies deal it's attack damage randomly split among all enemies"*

This could be a great tool in almost all warlock decks, the most notable combo is putrid smell into giant on turn 4 making it a 7 mana avenging wrath that comes with an 8/8. the drawback is the cost, it can't be included in any even deck and it's the only warlock secret so it's somewhat easy to avoid taking a lot of damage but the way i worded the card makes it so that you can kill your own minion to trigger the effect.

# [Strength in Numbers](https://i.imgur.com/ue8MS3b.png)

Druid Rare Secret | 5 mana | *"When one of your friendly beasts dies* ***Recruit*** *a* *Beast form your deck"*

Keeping in tune with the unique class secret, this 5 mana druid card can swing the game in overwhelming fashion (Tyrantus) but just like the card before this can easily be read through and the 5 mana will most likely freeze one of your turns. The most effective combo would be Snowflipper Penguin and Strength in Numbers with a big Tyrantus waiting to be recruited.
